vedic-philosophy.introduction:
Architecture in the Indian tradition includes temple architecture, civic planning, and principles often discussed under vastu and shilpa traditions. Temples are not only places of worship but also sophisticated works of geometry, acoustics, sculpture, and symbolic design.

This page provides an overview of how architectural principles connect craft, community life, and spiritual symbolism.

scripture_text.content: Architectural knowledge is preserved in shilpa and vastu-related texts and in living craft lineages. This site focuses on concepts (layout, symbolism, orientation, proportional design) rather than strict prescriptions.

vedic-philosophy.philosophical_explanation: Philosophically, sacred architecture expresses an inner map: movement from the outer world toward a still center. Proportion and order become a way to cultivate attention and reverence. Even outside temples, these principles highlight harmony between function, beauty, and meaning.
